The First District Appellate Court ruled Tuesday that the circuit court did not abuse its discretion in refusing a preliminary injunction, finding American failed to prove irreparable harm and that blocking the move would have inflicted greater disruption on United Airlines and airport operations.

After the federal court flagged a diversity-jurisdiction defect — both airlines are Delaware corporations — American voluntarily dismissed and refiled in Cook County circuit court on July 16, moving for a preliminary injunction three weeks later.
